what: A model (Claude Haiku 4.5) reads a drawing search query and proposes the kind, dimension intervals, material and exclusions; a proposal is kept only when its quote is in the query, and it replaces the pattern reading only where its quote contains the pattern's span (retrieval/understanding.py). Ten workshop phrasings per family built from the generator's gold: range, cm, 이상, number without unit, English, particle, plain control, material exclusion, unit spelled out, no spaces. Scored field by field in millimetres against the expected conditions for the pattern reading and the model-merged reading; then the same queries through the hybrid search (exact + BM25 + E5) ordered by each reading's conditions, scored against the drawings whose gold satisfies the query, with the RRF top-20 pool's recall as the bound. Harness fitwitness.evaluation.query_understanding, workflow query-understanding-evaluation. dev split first, test split once, nothing changed between them.

protocol.tuning: phrasings and prompt written before any call; dev split first, test once; no change after a test score
protocol.relevance: retrieval: same kind, gold inside every stated interval, material as asked, excluded material absent
